args.title: Document S3_ENDPOINT and bucket setup for MinIO in README
args.body:
File: README.md

In the 'Running locally' section, step 2 (or 3) should explicitly mention that when using MinIO you must set S3_ENDPOINT (e.g. S3_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:9000) in the .env file, and that the bucket must be created manually in the MinIO console before the first upload.

label: docs
file: README.md
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The 'Running locally' section tells users to start a MinIO container but never mentions setting S3_ENDPOINT (e.g. S3_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:9000) in .env, nor that the bucket must be created manually in the MinIO console, which is why the reporter hit a getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND error against the default AWS endpoint.
